result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder regexes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/TestConventions.java` (lines 75–76).

- **Before:** `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`. These needed at least one allowed character after `mock`, so a plain `mock/` folder didn't match. Punctuation or non-ASCII characters after `mock` didn't match either.
- **After:** `.*/__mock[^/]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/]*/.*`. Any folder name starting with `mock` or `__mock` now matches, whatever follows. The match can't cross a `/`, so `remock/`, `demo/` and `src/main/java/` don't match. Files like `mock.java` and `mockery.java` don't match either, because the pattern requires a `/` after the folder name.

I didn't touch the backslash handling. `SourceFileFilter.matches` already tries each path with its separators normalised, so Windows-style paths work with the same patterns.

I ran the `*Convention*` tests in `codeanalyzer`. The run reported no failures, but I didn't add tests for the new cases and didn't check them one by one. That includes `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/`, `mock-größe/`, `mock模拟/`, backslash paths, and the negatives above. I also didn't check the previously matched folders (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`). By the regex they still match, since each starts with `mock` or `__mock`.
